description: Track whether a Socratic thread opened during a session was ever resolved. A "dangling thread" is a question Zug asked (or should have asked) that the user deflected, changed subject from, or never answered. At natural session pauses or wind-down, surface the unresolved thread: "We didn't finish the thought about X." This is the one multi-signal health indicator unique to havruta that isn't already visible to the user. Simpler than a full multi-signal health system — one well-defined signal, one behavioral output. Store thread state in session metadata (in-memory during session, persisted in zug_end_session if unresolved).
title: Dangling Socratic thread detector — surface unresolved havruta threads at session end
